header: NNF FELLOWSHIP FOR DOCTORS APRIL 2024 EXAMINATION — THEORY PAPER I. Answer all the questions. Total Marks: 100. Time: 3 hours.

questions.stem: An antenatal patient who has completed 26 weeks of gestation, has come with very high blood pressure and impending eclampsia. The obstetric team is planning to deliver the baby.

sub_parts.label: a
sub_parts.text: LIST two important antenatal interventions to improve the survival chances and long-term neurological outcomes. (2)

sub_parts.label: b
sub_parts.text: LIST two SPECIFIC delivery room interventions that are necessary for this delivery (2)

sub_parts.label: c
sub_parts.text: Describe the postnatal strategies for prevention of intraventricular hemorrhage (IVH); describe the screening protocol for IVH (4+2).

questions.stem: A term 8-day old neonate presented with encephalopathy and was found to have a Serum Sodium value of 185 meq/L.

sub_parts.label: a

sub_parts.label: b

sub_parts.label: c

questions.stem: A term baby delivered for cord prolapse didn't cry after birth, and required extensive resuscitation including intubation and ventilation, chest compression and one dose of adrenaline. A stable heart rate was established, and the baby was shifted to NICU at 20 minutes of life.

sub_parts.label: a

sub_parts.label: b
sub_parts.text: LIST the criteria for deciding therapeutic hypothermia (3)

sub_parts.label: c
sub_parts.text: Describe the morbidities and modifiable factors that determine outcome of a baby with perinatal asphyxia (other than therapeutic hypothermia) (5)

questions.stem: A 40 weeks/3.3 kg presented on day 6 of life with history of poor feeding and lethargy. On examination the baby had poor sensorium, shallow breathing, and very poor suck. The heart rate was 134, Capillary refill time was 2 seconds, blood sugar 75 mg/dL, and CRP negative. Capillary blood gas showed pH of 7.45, PO2 100, PCO2 50, and HCO3 of 28, while on nasal canula oxygen of FiO2 0.25. Serum ammonia was 835 µg/dL.

sub_parts.label: a
sub_parts.text: What is the most likely diagnosis? (1)

sub_parts.label: b
sub_parts.text: Describe the initial emergency care (3)

sub_parts.label: c
sub_parts.text: What confirmatory tests are required? (2)

sub_parts.label: d
sub_parts.text: Describe the protocol of screening all newborn babies to detect similar conditions in pre-symptomatic stage. (4)
